When accessing an attribute of a single resource, write `<resource_type>.<resource_name>.<attribute>` without quotes.
The VPC resource is defined as `resource "aws_vpc" "main"`, so its exported identifier attribute is accessed as `aws_vpc.main.id`.
Replace the empty strings `""` assigned to `vpc_id` in `aws_internet_gateway.gw`, `aws_subnet.public`, and `aws_route_table.public` with `aws_vpc.main.id`.
